notes.title: Alpha 0.2.0 Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/3f39e328a33517fc86f9bd64278b67fb62ca4d63.jpg[/img]

Today's update focuses on the mission control screen, specifically on mission details which are important if you want to complete the mission and earn the bonus. Now, instead of presenting the details on an optional second dialog (which apparently no one bothered to read) the details are spelled out clearly when you select it. Also, importantly, if your rocket does not have the necessary parts to undertake the mission, the "accept" button will not be available.

The other significant change for players is that it is no longer mandatory to select a mission in order to test foods with one of the flyable testers. Instead, you can test any food in one of the testers by flying to the designated altitude range indicated by the colored band in the left hand panel. When the rocket enters that altitude band, hit "test" in the stages panel. The same instructions apply for missions to test specific foods.

Finally, in appreciation of our Kickstarter backers, the named comets, satellites, ufos, planets and food trucks now appear in the credits scene.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.24 live -- Finally!
notes.content:
Alpha 0.1.24 took much longer than expected to come out. The principle work involved a complete rewrite of the file save system, with an eye to much better future backward compatibility. Unfortunately, we hit a lot of unexpected bumps along the way delaying it much longer than anticipated.

Steam cloud saves are now enabled, meaning your game saves will be available on any of your machines with Steam installed. Also, your preferences -- audio and the like -- are now honored between playing sessions.

With this out of the way, we look forward to getting back to adding more content!

notes.title: 0.1.23: Happy New Year with tons of new Rocket Parts!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/2721c4aba1aa1aa36d9e8dc42124f0be8ec3bd7e.png[/img]

Hope everyone had a great holiday! to celebrate the new year, we're rolling out a pile of new rocket parts. Notewothy: this update contains the first 2-pin parts -- you'll need the right connectors in order to add them to your rocket. Also: two new classes of fin parts give thrust bonuses based on the presence of certain nutrients. For example, the D-Dyno Fin gives a significant thrust bonus if the food/fuel has a significant amount of Vitamin D.


Happy New Year!

notes.content:
Our intrepid bug reporters have brought our attention to a few ickies that needed to be squashed. Thank you folks!

    [*]Bug reporter wasn't giving back keyboard control after window closed -- OOOF! fixed
    [*]Missing tank and misaligned nose cone in intro animation -- fixed
    [*]Some part names in "Here are some parts" intro scene incorrectly named
[/list]

Thanks again for pointing these out -- now back to cranking out rocket parts and planets!

notes.title: New Rocket Parts, Mission Generator in 0.1.17
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/bff5ece3b7f82c76264853446793be7611e8c856.png[/img]
Last night's update to 0.1.17 brings three new rocket parts to play with:
[list]
    [*]The Blaaat! Booster, more powerful than the Mama booster, but carbs-restricted.
    [*]The flying Carbo-analyzer, an instrument you can load with food and fly to research carbohydrate, sugar and fiber food properties.
    [*]The flying Elemental Spectrometer, an instrument you can load with food to research elements contained in food, such as Sodium, Potassium & Iron.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/ba3061b0ca8f020fe78353074ef18ed5f6baa179.png[/img]
Under the hood, we've completely revamped and upgraded the mission generation system. The missions now have a greater variety both in type and the rewards for successful completion. Be sure to check the mission description for full details of what to do. Importantly, most missions now expire after some minutes, so always check the mission board before equipping your rocket with parts and food!

notes.title: Hotfix patch uploaded for 0.1.16
notes.content:
We've uploaded a patch that addresses a couple of issues posted out by you, the teeming millions in the last 24 hours.

-- It was possible to run out of food on Krunchon -- if enough fell into the drink, eventually leaving you stranded.
-- The button on the title screen for the tutorial has been removed. We've changed so many things with the main game loop that the existing tutorial made no sense. We'll circle back to that ASAP.


While a "Load" button now appears on the main screen, it currently does nothing. We're very busy overhauling that bit of code. We expect that to be fixed with the next update.

Thanks as always for your support!

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.4: Launch the Goldfish!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/cdde3b8b76ea6f2c16766c2a48921560ac1e14b0.png[/img]

Alpha 0.1.14 was released last night, with quite a few changes and additions. 

Additions include two new rocket parts: Boomerang Fins and the Goldfish Bowl.
There is now a Steam Achievement for acing the quiz. 

Magic coins have a 50% chance of awarding you money or offering the aforesaid quiz, which is worth a lot more if you can manage 75% or better.  

There are now a varierty of instruments and tools unlock-able on Terra's surface. The recycle bin speeds up the process of selecting the food items you want. The scale allows you to weigh food. (Hint: the calorie analyzer rocket part will work with any size food item -- bigger food items weigh more!)

Here's the complete changelog for 0.1.4:

[code]Alpha 0.1.14 12/3/17

Additions:
Boomerang Fins
Fish Bowl
new Quiz Ace Achievement
Carbo & Calorie Analyzers unlock-able on field


Changes:
Some renaming of rocket parts
new art for medium size fuel tank
revised blueprint style
revised icon for all rocket parts
last food data shown persists on billboard after dropping food item
tweaks to money animation
tweaks to mission goals and awards


Bug Fixes:
Cheddar cheese & Avocado serving sizes were 0, resulting in 0 cals on billboard
Orbit button had long delay
data bars on billboard fixed


Known Issues:
Rocket nerfed after abort or blowing up (temporary workaround: go to hangar and return)

Next Update Scheduled for:
8/12/17
[/code]

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.13 "Lucky 13" marks one week on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/cc541c0c527cce9807547beb221e8d675047874d.jpg[/img]
Lots of changes, both visible and not. First of all, food loaded into the rocket now costs money! You'll have to watch your finances a little more carefully than before.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/70583377a56e82e5863a56fa737377775a84f83b.jpg[/img]
The hangar continues to get more polished. Locked parts are shown, along with hints at what mission you need to perform to unlock them. More detailed stats of the parts you have unlocked are also now shown.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/952e38e3be2517c3d9f9bdc6b25a36afe50c71ea.jpg[/img]
The launch screen now features a more complete mission debrief, with a summary showing the overall flight result, along with a breakdown of the individual flight goals, and whether they succeeded or if not, why they failed. Hopefully this will take some of the mystery out of things.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/01d34af4662cb53ccaf3f7ee7867b5eca98492a0.jpg[/img]
Finally, we've started tweaking the Deep Space UI. In this pass we've simply concentrated on trying to make the prompts for the controls a little more clear.

Along with these changes are lots of bug squashing, big and small. I'm looking forward to adding a bunch of new rocket parts in the next days, as well as open up a couple more planets.

Thanks everyone for the support, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.6 Hotfix for broken Hangar now up
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/af52034a791597f12e01828c71ae964a61aa8b5a.png[/img]

The last update inadvertently made it impossible to save a rocket; 0.1.6 fixes that and does away with the previous save scheme. Now instead of saving whole rockets, you save designs, which can be applied to the current rocket at will, as long as you can afford the parts! We think this is a lot more intuiative and far less confusing (I suppose that is a tautology, but whatever...)

3 Days to go!

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.4 Available to testers
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/7c5b3cc181c3fd3ff5e49d61ee59672726f839bf.png[/img]

Today's Alpha release features a streamlined parts purchasing system; gone is the shop and parts inventory. Instead parts are purchased directly in the hangar. Cost is deducted from your savings when the part is placed on the blueprint. Deleted parts earn refunds.


Also in this update -- constraints have been removed from the field; you can fly as far to the left and right as you like. And the Hangar and Mission Control are now represented on the field, and you can travel to them when you hover nearby.


Change log:

Alpha 0.1.4
Additions:
Hangar on Field
Mission Control Building on Field
Steam Achievements implemented

Changes:
Removed double logo on start
Removed left and right constraints
Hangar and Mission Control triggers are no longer modal
Streamlined rocket part purchasing system: parts are purchased in the hangar as they are placed; no longer a separate shop screen
Visual improvents in hangar UI
splat sprites on crash no longer extend beyond foreground
All new rocket part and copter art


Bug Fixes:
Mass wasn’t properly calculated on multi-stage rockets after jettison
No longer possible to fly off edges of world (blastoff)
settings return button fixed
